findings.title: Silence does nothing for Prometheus-only Grafana rows
findings.body: Grafana list rows now pass only promRule, leaving rule undefined. The menu exposes Silence notifications using the new Prometheus abilities, but clicking it only sets showSilenceDrawer; this condition still requires a Grafana ruler rule before rendering the drawer. Consequently, the advertised action does nothing in the new list. Fetch the required ruler rule on demand or adapt the drawer to accept the Prometheus rule.

findings.title: Pause and Delete remain gated on the removed ruler data
findings.body: The new Grafana list supplies promRule without rulerRule. Although this component now calculates Pause and Delete permissions from promRule, the Pause item still requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule), and the Delete item still requires rulerRule. Both actions therefore disappear from every Grafana row in the new list, including for users with update/delete permissions. The rendering and handlers need a Prometheus-only path or an on-demand ruler fetch.

findings.title: Return neutral abilities when skipToken is supplied
findings.body: skipToken is converted to undefined, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) still returns Duplicate as supported and checks the user's Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu passes skipToken for non-Grafana rules and ORs this result with the source-specific ruler ability. A user with Grafana create permission but no write permission on an external rule source therefore gets a Duplicate action for that external rule. Skipped abilities must return false/false rather than granting Grafana abilities to unrelated rules.

findings.title: Preserve the federated-group immutability check
findings.body: Delegating CombinedRule abilities to useAllRulerRuleAbilities drops the previous isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) check. The delegated implementation hardcodes isFederated to false, so existing useAlertRuleAbility consumers now advertise Update and Delete for Mimir groups containing source_tenants whenever the user has write permission. These groups were deliberately treated as immutable because federated-rule editing is unsupported. Preserve the group’s federation status when delegating.

findings.title: Keep export available for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: ModifyExport now requires a Grafana alerting rule, whereas the previous ruler-based ability supported both Grafana alerting and recording rules. GrafanaRuleListItem now supplies only promRule, so recording rules have no ruler-based export fallback and lose the Export menu even for users with read permission. Use the Grafana-managed rule check for export rather than the alerting-only check.

findings.title: Preserve the return destination on rule-view links
findings.body: The previous list item included createReturnTo() in the rule-view URL, but this replacement drops the returnTo parameter. Opening a rule from a filtered list therefore no longer gives the viewer’s return link the original list URL and search parameters, losing the user's filtering context when returning. Retain the returnTo parameter while changing the row's data source.
